description: Share of the AOI's area covered by the Feature API result: the answered grid cells' area over the AOI's area for a gridded AOI, 1.0 for an AOI answered in one request. Null when the Feature API did not answer for the AOI.

Area of the AOI covered by the Feature API result (answered_area_fraction times the AOI's area). Use it as the denominator for a share-of-AOI figure such as percent cover, so failed grid cells don't count as observed. Null when the Feature API did not answer for the AOI, or the AOI was given as an address.
